notes.title: Goodbye... or maybe not? Ginger's Letter to Santa IS OUT!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Earthlings!!

We are today announcing a new game we just released for Christmas, Ginger's Letter to Santa, although this game has a bit of a bittersweet story behind it. As many of you are aware, Keylocker has not recouped as of today, leaving us on a big financial pit. The whole game's industry has been on a freefall for a while, lots of layoffs and companies going bankrupt. AI is threatening jobs as we speak.

This game is a big gift to fans who supported our work, everyone who bought Keylocker and patiently waited for updates, anyone who remained loyal to us, to those who wrote positive reviews, bought our previous games to gift to friends, or to anyone who ever talked about us in a good light out there and spread the word. To anyone who visited us at PAX, Gamescom, Tokyo Game Show, Bitsummit, Brazil Game Show, you are incredible people who completely saved me when I was at my worst times. I actually started game development after my dad died and it's saved me back then and still saves me to this day, there's nothing that makes my day more than your kindness towards us all these years. This is such a small gift for how much you've given us and it's something I'd like to even give for free, but on our current situation, that's not possible. 

I would like to be sincere with people, not that I'm one to hide anything from you! This game might also be our last game as of date if things continue the way they are for our little company. Everyone working for Moonana works for a wage, although our wages weren't great, I was able to pay everyone wages for years now, which is a miracle for a small indie company. We're encountering problems getting investment for our newest title, and getting investment for that could save us for the next years to come of that game's development and while we wait for Keylocker to pick up. Getting investment for that game could also save Moonana altogether. If you are wondering why updates for Keylocker have been a bit slow, that's why! We're spending a lot of our time trying to come up with solutions for our current money situation, because we want everyone to be able to continue working properly, and keep their passion alive. I can't imagine Anglerman doing anything other than creating little creatures and little game systems and sitting on his piano chair like a gremlin every day doing what he loves most: Games. Or bear, what would bear do, even? Man has been literally saving lives with his music for so long that not working on that would completely kill the sparkle on his eyes when he comes up with that one melody that lives in our minds rent free forever. All and everyone who works now with Moonana and want to join us in the future, like Tara (we really have a big dream of making Tara into an official worker if we get that promised investment for Clowned King). There's just a lot of dreams we have for this company. We poured a lot of those dreams into this game. Is this game about going bankrupt? Absolutely not, this game is about dreams, and christmas miracles, and making peace with each other regardless of our differences.

So, we sincerely hope you will enjoy this game despite of our struggles, although I wanted to be sincere with you guys. As of now we will continue to pursue all avenues we can to keep the dream alive, and we won't give up. There are still many publishers to contact, and we want to find the one who is worthy of our work, and worthy of our fandom. You will be the first to know whether we're successful or not, and with this little game, please do share it with your friends. We're releasing it during the Steam sale so this game's visibility is completely blocked from Steam front page. Having the fans sharing this is all we have now.


And now, for what's this game is about!

[previewyoutube=FXb8hAfYZiw;full][/previewyoutube]

Ginger's Letter to Santa is a short Christmas story taking place in the Virgo Versus The Zodiac universe after the events of the Cardinal Ending. This game does not contain spoilers related to the Cardinal Ending, and it's a good entry title if you'd like to become acquainted with the Virgo Versus The Zodiac universe. Consider it a little Christmas present from us in the Moonana team to the fans of our first game on the 5 year anniversary of it's release!

The game is available now for $3.99 with a 10% launch discount, but owners of Virgo Versus The Zodiac can get the Virgo x Ginger Christmas Bundle for an additional 15% discount!

You can view the Steam Page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3392430/Gingers_Letter_to_Santa/

It's almost Christmas, and Ginger is looking for a recipe to the Best Roast Christmas Dinner the Zodiacs has ever seen!

"They will all scream for more and then nobody will try to eat me, no more no more!"

..but to get the recipe he'll have to enlist the help of his friend, Sullyvan the Salarylamb, if he wants to have any hope of making it to Santa's Factory. Join Ginger, Sullyvan and the mysterious Christmas Gonk as they travel the lengths of Capricorn's realm in search of Santa's Factory so they can deliver their letters, and Ginger can save himself from being eaten, again.

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year! New Chinese Zodiac game teaser!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/b67baf6712bae4577b5ed137559cd32060b48849.png
Happy Lunar New Year! 


I'd like to talk about a project that we plan to work on after Keylocker is complete! That is Dragon Versus The Zodiac, exploring the world of the Chinese Zodiac, that we're announcing today in homage to the year of the dragon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/8d99d9eae002b553cb4b1657ec32a29208bd8c5f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/9f1c84d96c36bdb4b3babbd347b206bb37b43daa.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/3a0aaa54505e7e2d3abf81f98d8cda456399c750.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/a871087842524b46f3c1ac3d22edaf8a059459a4.png

Dragon Versus The Zodiac initially follows the Rat and Cat (an ostracized figure of the Chinese Zodiac). Both are mortal enemies united only to free the Dragon who has been sealed for more than 100 years on the Tree of Fates in the realm of Bunny, to save her from the devious bunnies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/40343da2a2c2bb3e6b8379f0edf4054fb161efd9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/fc6374ab34838ece138063e979abf2f40b725379.png

The Protagonist is Dragon, and Bunny is the first antagonist of the game. You will also see the Rooster, Tiger, Pig, Horse and Snake’s realms. This game is programmed as a side project we will work together with our next mainline games, so it will be smaller than the others, but it will probably still be packed with content if you know us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/3809dbdcb9ad11b4430ca5d2fd7638b3eb2fc743.gif

The gameplay and art style are similar to Virgo Versus The Zodiac and we plan to develop this game on the same engine as VvtZ, with some improvements from the Keylocker engine. In this game you unlock a Dragon Turn where your party will 'transform' into its Zodiac animal form.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33661629/b8f3922d5136781e252d9b596c7d4a2768061009.png

Although there’s nothing much to show and we’re not really developing this game atm, I wanted to share our plans for the future and our excitement about exploring the Chinese Zodiac lore. You will hear here first when we have a steam page and an actual game to show!

Nana

notes.title: Content Update: Boss Rush mode and Bonus Zodiac Memories: Play as the Zodiacs!
notes.content:
Hello, Surviving Life Forms!!!

[previewyoutube=oX1YgeIN8vE;full][/previewyoutube]

Today is the most awaited day of the year when Moonana releases that update promised on the Crowdfunding Campaign thousands of years ago, to prove not only this amazing team has excellent memory, but we are the keeper of promises, no matter how long it takes. This update contains the following:

Zodiac Memories

Enter the memories of Aquarius, Scorpio, Libra and Gemini and enjoy a new window into the perspectives of these Zodiac. As Aquarius, board her airship and discover what happened while Virgo rode the Megalithic Train to Leo's Golden Colosseum. As Scorpio, set sail down the River Styx and traverse through the Unholy Cabaret. As Libra, enter the Astrological Court and oversee the 101st Eye Removal Tournament. As Gemini, return to the Dioskourai Library to clean up the virus infestation and discover the truth of the Indexers plot.


Boss Rush

In this special challenge mode, Virgo, Spica and Algol will take on the Zodiac in the sequence of their appearance in game. Before each fight you will be given a chance to upgrade and equip your characters with a set amount of resources at your disposal. Each victory will see your resources increase until you've successfully overcome all Zodiacal forces. Prepare your strategy, make your build and defeat the Zodiac in this special mode which is sure to test even the most veteran Virgo Versus The Zodiac player.

The game is currently out everywhere as well, you guys can stop asking me while I withheld all this important information!!! So make sure to get it on all of your preferred platforms.

Thank you very much for following the game for this many years and for your patience on waiting for this update and the game's launch to every single platform ever created.

I hope you have fun, I had loads of fun working on this update with the guys.

Your forever Alpaca of the Moonana lands,
Nana Moon.

notes.title: Virgo Versus The Zodiac is coming to consoles on August 23
notes.content:
HELLO, MY BELOVED HERETICS OF THE COSMOS!

I am Nana Moon, lead director at Moonana, you might have met me in 2022 when I showed "Keylocker | Turn Based Cyberpunk Action" at PAX East, Bitsummit and Gamescom as well! When I visited the US for PAX, it was my first trip there and I was welcomed by fans who were meeting me for the first time. Some came just to see Keylocker because they liked Virgo Versus The Zodiac, some were there to try out demos and stumbled upon our booth and fell in love for the first time. I was even sitting, eating my food by myself at some point, and someone asked to take a picture with me, I got very emotional about it! Who would've thought!

Having the chance to travel again in 2022, and this time to the US, Japan and Europe has allowed me to meet so many of you who cared for my game and I am very thankful to have such dedicated fans.

With that being said, now I have excellent news for all of you: Virgo Versus The Zodiac will be out for the Nintendo Switch, Playstation and Xbox on August 23rd, 2023, the beginning of the astrological Virgo season, digitally. We are also including new free content such as: extra Zodiac Memories where you can play as some of the Zodiacs that didn't have dedicated realms and Boss Rushes with all the Zodiac Bosses overhauled to offer more challenge. This content will be released at the same time for the PC version of the game.

I've partnered with Serenity Forge who will be supporting us with publishing and marketing efforts, as well as some other things which we are not quite ready to talk about yet! 

I hope you'll be able to enjoy Virgo Versus The Zodiac again on your preferred platform, and enjoy our new trailer that was hand animated by T-ARA#376 and remember your favorite characters, scenes and battles. For everyone who backed Virgo Versus The Zodiac on our crowdfunding campaign, thank you for your patience waiting for the console versions and added content that we promised many years ago. We are finally able to share all of this with you.

Thank you very much, and be ready to soon exterminate some more Heretics!

Now our new publisher will have a few words:

Virgo Versus The Zodiac is coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox platforms on August 23.

[previewyoutube=OGYRWl2wI0k;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s time to take to the stars and correct the mistakes of your peers. The beloved, beautiful, and brutally difficult pixel art JRPG Virgo Versus The Zodiac is coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox platforms on August 23, the first day of the Virgo constellation!

Wishlist the game on your platform of choice today:
https://serenityforge.com/games/virgo-versus-the-zodiac

As Virgo, your quest to restore the cosmos is a righteous one: bring back the Golden Age of peace and balance to the Zodiac Realms. Some might call your quest unforgiving, and even twisted, but those heretics don’t know what they’re talking about. She is definitely the hero of this story.

Undertake a fateful journey to the stars with:
A unique turn-based combat system featuring timed-actions and counterattacks that favors a balance of offense and defense, rewarding a deliberate mind and swift fingers. 

No Random Encounters: Every fight is a bespoke challenge designed specifically for your quest.
A focus on exploration with multiple endings: There are many people, places, and items to see among the stars, and each interaction could be the one that determines your fate!

New content including a Boss Rush mode and never-before-seen Zodiac Memories.

So, find your fate amongst the stars on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox when Virgo Versus The Zodiac launches on August 23rd!

Fans can also join the Serenity Forge Discord to talk about the game and keep to date with all its developments. 
https://discord.gg/serenityforge

That's it, guys, thank you so much for sticking to us and for supporting our work, we at Moonana love you all!

notes.title: Unofficial Korean language support added!
notes.content:
Although not provided by the developer or publisher, the work of a single dedicated fan who goes by the name Gemini has produced a full Korean translation of Virgo Versus the Zodiac, which you can download and apply to the game easily by following the link below. We fully support the fan community, and love to see this level of dedication -- it speaks to the passion and heart that went into the game's development and shows just how much the fanbase has fallen in love with its world and characters.

Here's a brief statement on the matter from the game's creator, Nana, in Korean and English -- along with the link to download, for those who are interested.

Enjoy, and genuinely, thank you for playing Virgo Versus the Zodiac. Your support means the world to us!

안녕하세요, 한국의 팬 여러분!

notes.title: Version 1.1.3 Patch: Fixed a game-crashing bug in chapter one
notes.content:
We discovered a game-crashing bug in patch 1.1.2 that would consistently occur right after the cutscene with Pisces and Ginger on the zeppelin.

The issue has already been fixed, and the version was updated to 1.1.3. Everyone should be able to progress through the game without encountering any issues at the end of chapter one. We deeply apologize for any inconvenience that this issue may have caused.


 Fixed a crash that was accidentally introduced in the previous version.

notes.title: v1.1.2 Patch, Demo Version, and New Game Details!
notes.content:
A new free demo of Virgo Versus the Zodiac has been released, comprising the entirety of the Capricorn realm. The game executable has been updated as well for compatibility so that players who complete the demo and then purchase the full game will be able to pick up right where they left off.

Version 1.1.2 patch details


 Cleaned up some cutscenes in Capricorn realm.
 Added save transfer support for completed demo saves


and... the creator from Moonana has something that she wants to share with every Virgo fan!

Hello, citizens of Earth!
I hope you are having a good day!
The world is in a very bad place right now, but I hope you're all safe and living a healthy life filled with cool games!

To bring some good news, recently we launched a Steam page for our newest game. It's called Keylocker | Turn-Based Cyberpunk Action!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325040

The gameplay is similar to Virgo, so I hope you guys will enjoy our newest game, too!
If you guys could wishlist, please do so! Wishlisting helps us a lot in bringing attention to the game when it's launched. The more wishlists there are, the more attention we can get within Steam's mysterious algorithms!!

Please do check our gameplay video as well on YouTube: it shows 15 mins of our very, very early alpha/complete beginning of the game/development!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oFj-LSnyOlY
I hope you all have a great day!

Nana.

notes.title: Degica & Moonana will be attending Japan's largest indie event BitSummit 7 Spirits!
notes.content:
A big hello to all the Degica & Moonana fans out there!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/7047f9a1426919c77856fd8e95014b89e8176c8b.jpg

We here at Degica Games are proud to announce our publishing partnership with Moonana the team behind the unforgiving timed action turn-based JRPG Virgo Vs The Zodiac! (VVTZ for short!)

Get ready to "Embark on a cosmic quest to follow your fate, or defy your destiny" this Autumn 2019.

Along with the news of our publishing partnership, Degica and Moonana will be attending Japan's largest Indie Game event, BitSummit 7 Spirits, from June 1st & 2nd at Miyako Messe in Kyoto. If you are in Kyoto come on by and check out the special Virgo Vs The Zodiac demo we will have on display and meet the Moonana team!

About Virgo VS The Zodiac:
Virgo Vs The Zodiac is a sci-fi/fantasy JRPG inspired by the Mario & Luigi RPG series and the Mother RPG series in which you play as an obsessed villain. The game features traditional turn-based combat with real-time execution of moves: blocking, countering and timing your attacks carefully as well as predicting your foes' moves is essential to succeed in Virgo's twisted and unforgiving cosmic quest to bring back the Golden Age, a period of peace, symmetry and balance, or so she thinks. In this galaxy where every action means a reaction, you’ll play as Virgo, the Holy Queen, often called Dreadful Queen by heretics, bringing mayhem to the Zodiac Realms and leaving a trail of stardust on the way, all to fit her excessively righteous worldview. 

Special Origins Interview:
You can also get a glimpse into the beginnings of the game and how it came to be in this special interview article with the creator Nana.

http://blog.rpgmakerweb.com/interview/virgo-vs-the-zodiac/

BitSummit 7 Spirits
Those who attend the event will be able to try out the exciting battle demo in either English or Japanese!
Attendees who have tried the demo will receive a random acrylic keychain of a character from Virgo Vs The Zodiac! 

For those who come to see us at our booth, we will be also handing out Steam keys for the BitSummit demo version, along with an original designed clear file! 
Supplies are limited so be sure to stop by!
